verses.text: Ha tiknaik, ol walb'at t'ayex yuj jun ofrenda ol k'e waan t'a he kal, yik ol ak'jok t'a heb' yikxo Dios. Ha juntzanh cheknab'il ol walb'at t'ayex tik, walnakxo t'a heb' creyente t'a yol yik Galacia. Yuj chi', icha syutej sb'a heb' chi', icha chi' ol eyutok he b'a.
Junjun ex tzeyik'el eyofrenda t'a junjun domingoal, hato syala' jantak tzeyak' ganar, tze molb'ani. Tato icha chi', manhokto tzin k'ochi, tzeyak'an lista eyofrenda.

Tze say jaywanhok heb' ol in chekb'at t'a Jerusalén. Hato ol in k'ochok ol in b'oan jun carta ol b'at yet' heb', yik ol ilchajok to ay yopisio heb'. Haton heb' chi' ol ik'anb'at eyofrenda t'a heb' creyente ta'.
Ayik ol in k'och eyet' ta', ol wila'' talaj a in ol in b'at lak'an yet' heb' t'a Jerusalén chi'. Tato icha chi', wet' ol b'at heb'.
Ayik ol in b'at ex wila'', yowalil ol in ek' chab' oxeok k'ual t'a yol yik Macedonia, ichato chi' ol in k'och t'ayex.
Ta icha chi' ol in ek' niwanok tiempo eyet' ta'. Talaj ay in ek' ta' ol ek' nhab'ilk'inal. Haxo yik ol in b'atxok, ol ex kolwaj t'ayin t'a yol b'e b'aj ol in b'atxok chi'.
In gana manh elanhchamelok tzin ek' t'ayex. In gana tzin ek' niwanok tiempo heyet'ok, tato icha chi' tz'el t'a sk'ool Kajal Jesús.
Palta ay in to ek' t'a Éfeso tik, masanto ol ek' k'inh Pentecostés, haxo in b'at chi'.
Yujto swila' to te wach'nhej tz'elk'och in munlajel t'a yik Kajal Jesús t'a tik. Wach'chom tzijtum heb' schichonoch sk'ool t'ayin, palta jakannhej in munlaji, ay pax tas swik' t'a in munlajel tik.
Tato ol k'och winhaj Timoteo t'ayex ta', tzeyak' tzalajb'ok sk'ool winh heyet'ok, yik manh ol kus winh, yujto ha t'a yik Kajal Jesús smunlaj winh icha in tik.

Yuj chi', malaj junok ex tze patikejel winh ta'. Ha inxo tik, wan in tanhwan sja winh t'a tik yet' juntzanhxo heb' kuk'tak ol ja yet' winh, yuj chi' ayik ol kot winh t'a yol b'e, tzex kolwajkot t'a winh, sek yuj chi' tzalajk'olal ol kot winh.
Haxo winh kuk'tak Apolos, ix in tewi t'a winh, yik sb'at winh ex yila'. Palta max yal sk'ool winh sb'at ex yil t'a jun pekti' tik. Hato yik ol och skolanil winh, ol b'at ex yilan winh.
Makwajanhek. Tek'an tzeyutej he b'a eyak'anoch Kajal Jesús t'a he k'ool. Manh ex xiw jab'ok. Tek'b'ejek he b'a junjun ex.
Ha jantaknhej tas tze k'ulej, tze k'ulej t'a smasanil he k'ool yuj swach'ilok heb' ketanimail.

Ha tiknaik ex wuk'tak ex wanab' eyojtak to a winhaj Estéfanas yet' heb' kajan yet' winh t'a spat, b'ab'el creyente winh yet' heb' t'a yol yik Acaya b'aj ayex chi'. Ha heb' chi', syak' wal serwil heb' yetcreyenteal heb' t'a smasanil sk'ool.
Tzin k'an pawor t'ayex to tze k'anab'ajej tas syal heb'. Tze k'anab'ajan pax jantaknhej heb' lajan syutej sb'a icha heb' chi', haton heb' skolwaji, yet' smunlaj t'a yik Kajal Jesús.

Tzin tzalaj tiknaik, yujto ix ja winhaj Estéfanas wet' t'a tik yet' winhaj Fortunato yet' winhaj Acaico. Ha heb' winh tik, skolwaj wal heb' winh t'ayin. Ichato he k'exul yaj heb' winh skolwaj t'ayin t'a tik, yujto max yal-laj he jawi.

Icha ix yutej heb' winh yak'an sniwanil he k'ool ta', icha chi' syutej heb' winh yak'anpax sniwanil in k'ool t'a tik. Ayokab' yelk'och heb' winh t'ayex. Tato ay juntzanhxo heb' icha heb' winh tik, ayokab' pax yelk'och heb' t'ayex.

Ha heb' ay t'a junjun iglesia t'a yol yik Asia tik, syak'b'at stzatzil he k'ool heb' he masanil ta'. Hanhejtona' winhaj Aquila yet' ix Priscila yet' heb' creyente smolb'ej sb'a t'a spat heb', syak'paxb'at stzatzil he k'ool heb' t'a sb'i Kajal Jesús.
Syak'b'at stzatzil he k'ool masanil heb' creyente t'a tik. Slaj eyak'laj stzatzil he k'ool t'a tzalajk'olal ta'.
Ha stzatzil he k'ool swak'b'at tik, a in wal Pablo in tzin tz'ib'ejb'at yet' in k'ab'.
Tato ay junok mach max xajanan Kajal Jesucristo, kotokab' yowal sk'ool Dios t'a yib'anh. Ach Kajal, kotanh t'a elanhchamel.
Sch'oxokab' swach'k'olal Kajal Jesucristo t'ayex ta'.
Xajan ex he masanil wuuj yuj Cristo Jesús.
